The [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]] '''Deep Space Recovery Vessel L-2783''', more commonly called the '''L-2783''', was a small [[Bulk cruiser]] / [[Bulk transport]] designed to travel to remote locations to repair or recover damaged [[starship]]s.<ref name="Special Mods" />

==Characteristics==
Essentially a large cargo hold with engines attached, the L-2783 was based off of bulk cargo capital ship design, and sported a main cavernous cargo hold capable of containing and carrying ships up to the size of an old-style [[cruiser]].<ref name="Special Mods" /> Envisioned as a mobile repair base and scavenger ship, the L-2783's powerful tractor beam could pull in ships or wreckage as needed into its internal hold, with the hold capable of being partitioned off by enormous [[force field]]s.<ref name="Special Mods" />

Aiding the ship was a small fleet of four cargo shuttles and fifty maintenance / scavenger pods held in an aft facing hangar bay.<ref name="Special Mods" /> These small two-person spacecraft were equipped with clamps and [[Plasma cutter/Legends|plasma cutters]], allowing the pods to retrieve smaller objects or work in unison to dismantle larger objects.<ref name="Special Mods" /> Debris was then deposited into the L-2783's large dorsal cargo holds where it could be dealt with by a large array of onboard repair shops and supply vaults.<ref name="Special Mods" />

Coming stock with minimal weaponry, the L-2783 had heavy shields that were more than enough to protect it from [[pirate]]s and aggressive scavengers.<ref name="Special Mods" /> Like any [[Corellian Engineering Corporation|CEC]] design, however, the ship was vastly upgradable and customizable; as a result these ships were known to be retrofitted into small carriers along with with substantial upgrades to weapons and shielding.<ref name="Special Mods" />

==Roles==
The L-2783 was deployed in a myriad of fashions due to its large cargo capacity and heavy shielding.<ref name="Special Mods" /> [[Scavenger]]s made use of the L-2783 as full-time salvage craft, making their livings harvesting wrecks and debris.<ref name="Special Mods" /> Other L-2783's were converted into capable military carriers by [[mercenary]] groups and crime lords, while [[pirate]]s occasionally used the L-2783 as a pirate vessel - absconding with entire freighters by simply swallowing them up.<ref name="Special Mods" /> A few true entrepreneurs and businessmen used the L-2783 as a massive mobile repair base, using the L-2783's vast cargo capacity to service [[space station]]s and outposts - while even carrying out in-flight repairs on smaller vessels.<ref name="Special Mods" />
